title: WebP: One image format to rule them all
content:
<html><head></head><body>In my last article I wrote about the importance of images regarding performance. Hugo Giraudel pointed out, that I forgot to write about the WebP image format and he was right. So I needed to get myself familiar with this format in order to update my article. It turned it was impossible to summarise this amazing topic in a few sentences. This is why I decided to give WebP the attention it deserves and why I wrote this new little article about it.
            </body></html>
